content: Question: What payment methods do you accept? | Answer: We accept cash on delivery, bank transfers, and online payments through JazzCash and EasyPaisa.
question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept cash on delivery, bank transfers, and online payments through JazzCash and EasyPaisa.

content: Question: How long does delivery take? | Answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days nationwide. Express delivery is available in major cities and takes 1-2 business days.
question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days nationwide. Express delivery is available in major cities and takes 1-2 business days.

content: Question: Can I track my order? | Answer: Yes, you will receive a tracking number via SMS and email once your order is dispatched. You can track your order on our website.
question: Can I track my order?
answer: Yes, you will receive a tracking number via SMS and email once your order is dispatched. You can track your order on our website.

content: Question: What is your size guide? | Answer: Our size guide is available on each product page. We offer sizes from S to XXL. For unstitched fabric, measurements are provided in the product description.

content: Question: Do you offer international shipping? | Answer: Currently, we only ship within Pakistan. International shipping is not available at this time.
